listing_card.name: Baithak Foundation
listing_card.description: Baithak aims to use music exposure and training as an anchor in children's lives to keep them rooted, energized, motivated, curious and sensitive in the face of increasing stress and isolation.

profile.description: Baithak aims to use music exposure and training as an anchor in children's lives to keep them rooted, energized, motivated, curious and sensitive in the face of increasing stress and isolation.
profile.mission: Baithak envisions creating a society with equitable music access and learning opportunities for children from the most marginalized communities, believing that music exposure and education are as important as mainstream education.
profile.address_head_office: CTS No. 943/B-5, PMC Workers Society, Hanuman Nagar, Senapati Bapat Road, Pune, Maharashtra

Geographies Served Programs APT Project District Satara Pune Ratnagiri State Maharashtra District Satara Pune Ratnagiri States Maharashtra What is the APT Project? Anubhav ~ Inspire (Deeply moving experience) A series of highly experiential chamber concerts by young artists of Indian Traditional Music and Dance forms is hosted once every month. Parichay ~ Engage (Participative Engagement) A series of workshops that deepen the experience of art through participation. Hosted once every month for a select group of interested students. Taleem ~ Develop (Building Antifragility) Create a mindset capable of accepting challenges and failures. Develop an inward looking individual capable of patience, compassion and generosity. Create a community of practice through the learning club once every week. Pune Kabir Festival District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra Pune Kabir Festival is an endeavour anchored in the wisdom shared by Kabir and other saints. It is an attempt to bring the works of saints to the centre of our modern lives. Through participation, embodied presence and learning, the festival aims to bring us together in listening and celebrating words and wisdom that have lived for centuries. By blurring the lines between a performer and audience, we envision the creation of a truly collective effort to create a space for dialogue in our city. Curated Events District Pune State Maharashtra District Pune States Maharashtra Baithak Foundation team curates home concerts, public events, and thematic events that represent Indian Traditional art forms. We are partners with many reputed venues and event organisers in the city of Pune. Every year, Baithak curates 30+ such events. Baithak's Illustrated Books Baithak is continually working on a series of illustrated books to introduce and present personal histories of inspiring performing artists. It is an attempt to see the performers beyond their art - to explore what brought flavour to their life, what were the times they lived in, the people who were part of their journey and what mattered to them. These books are designed so that people of all ages and levels of exposure to traditional arts can enjoy them. In 2019, Baithak Foundation published ‘Freddy’ - an illustrated book featuring music and the life of Pt. Firoz Dastur. In 2024, we proudly published ‘Bhimsen’ and 'Pt. Omkarnath Thakur'.
